name: Kiln Grid
description: Rotated tiles interlocking into a diamond mosaic, hue blending diagonally between two ink colors like a run of kiln-fired clay.

code.style: --rule: ( --t: calc((@x + @y) / (@size-col + @size-row - 2)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color1) calc((1 - @var(--t)) * 100%), var(--color2) calc(@var(--t) * 100%)); filter: brightness(calc(0.75 + 0.5 * (@i / @size))); margin: -1px; transform: rotate(45deg) scale(1.42); transition: @r(1.2s) ease; );
